newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks stable in sparse London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks stable in sparse London trade.

text.p: Japanese shares were little changed in sparse London trading on Monday, with the Tokyo market closed for a holiday.
London's Nikkei ISE index was up 2.36 points at 1,417.20 by 1445 GMT. In Tokyo the key Nikkei 225 index on Friday closed up 166.20 points at 20,633.06.
Traders said there was no real activity in the market, which has been affected by the political uncertainty over the new coalition government.
The Nikkei 225 index is expected to continue downward this week, perhaps dipping below 20,000 if the situation continues.
"Unless we see some spectacular news coming out of Japan we will be trading lower for the rest of the week," said one trader.
